verified: Every attraction name below is canonical — taken from usj.co.jp/contentdata/usj/zh/tw on 2026-08-16 — except 名探偵コナン, whose zh-TW page was not published yet and whose name here is a guess. Note that USJ leaves some titles part-English on its own Chinese pages (咒術迴戰 The Real 4-D, 鏈鋸人 The Chaos 4-D, 《Resident Evil Requiem》深淵絕境); those are copied as USJ writes them, not normalised. The pass-name tokens below the attraction block are all best-effort: USJ coins them for the store only and publishes them nowhere in Chinese.
note: Japanese -> 繁體中文. The store's API translates attraction names and nothing else, so every other string it ships (a pass's name, its display prefix, its covered-attractions blurb) is translated here. Applied as longest-key-first substring replacement, which is why short tokens like トロッコ can sit alongside the full attraction names that contain them. Keys are written without ™ so they also match the blurb, where the store wraps it in <sup>. Anything with no key here renders in Japanese. Run `npm run i18n:check` to list what is missing.
